published_prior_art.cite: ZhuEtAl2025 uses a graph-cut surrogate; the proposed MILP is a routine but apparently new exact formulation for V.
CaselGiannopoulouNiklanovits2026 gives connected-partition DP with prescribed sizes, not scope-localized rational V costs or this certificate.
ZhuEtAl2025 optimizes a graph-cut surrogate and does not provide this positive-definite, entrywise-nonnegative ordering reversal.
Viviano2026ExperimentalDesign proves pilot-based variance-regret guarantees for a different two-wave network-design criterion; this deterministic argmin envelope is a routine supporting bound.
BodlaenderCyganKratschNederlof2015 supplies representative reduction for standard connectivity states, not the completed-label and nonlinear-scope extension relation.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1--4
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The causal derivation of the fair-coin residual multiplier is imported from Zhu et al.; the proposed results optimize the resulting fixed rational criterion rather than rederive its potential-outcome model.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Exact optimization, certification, reversal, and pilot regret conditional on ZhuEtAl2025's p=1/2 covariance-scope criterion V.

source_verification_receipts.locator: PMLR article page, bibliographic record and abstract
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited ICML paper exists with the listed authors and presents a graph-cut surrogate for spatial experimental-design MSE.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 3, 29--31, Theorem 23 and its DP correctness/runtime discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a bounded-treewidth dynamic program for connected partitions with prescribed sizes, including forget/join connectivity logic; it does not state the V objective or scope-localization result.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv precursor to Information and Computation 243 (2015)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The source defines empty-root nice decompositions with introduce-edge and join bags and unique edge introduction, supporting the standard decomposition assumptions.
The paper studies pilot-based two-wave network design and states variance-regret guarantees, but for its own design problem rather than V.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Promote the four-cycle calculation into a parameterized nondegenerate family and characterize an observable sufficient condition for surrogate/exact order agreement or strict reversal.

Add an empirical or model-based map from pilot data and assignment primitives to Sigma, so the exact certificate optimizes a fully specified experimental-design risk rather than only a frozen algebraic input.
Benchmark the DP state space against Casel et al.'s state representation and give a worked certificate instance larger than C4.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with the headline explicitly conditional on the imported Zhu p=1/2 criterion; retain the MILP and pilot-regret bound as supporting results to the field-tier exact-DP kernel.
